allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name, CPU, WorkingSet, Id | Format-Table -AutoSize")
Bash(powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id 90592, 96288 -Force; Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Start-Process explorer")

Bash(powershell -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process | Where-Object {$_Name -ne ''_Total'' -and $_Name -ne ''Idle''} | Sort-Object PercentProcessorTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Name, PercentProcessorTime, IDProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(powershell -Command "wmic path Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process get Name,PercentProcessorTime,IDProcess /format:csv 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Csv | Where-Object PercentProcessorTime -gt 1 | Sort-Object {[int]$_PercentProcessorTime} -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(node -e "const fs=require\(''fs''\); const files=fs.readdirSync\(''.''\).filter\(f=>f.includes\(''2352''\)||f.includes\(''2486''\)\); files.forEach\(f=>{ const buf=Buffer.from\(f\); console.log\(buf.slice\(0,6\).toString\(''hex''\), JSON.stringify\(f\)\); }\);")
